sub_palette: celtic (goidelic) backbone + near_eastern (egyptian) overlay (cross-family blend, Celtic-leaning)

blend.backbone: celtic (Insular / Goidelic register: ri/tuath/flaith, Mac-/O- patronymics, the fian war-band, initial mutation c>ch / b>bh / t>th / d>dh, broad vs slender consonants, root-initial stress, the brithem's law and the fili's praise)
blend.overlay: near_eastern (egyptian: the itru river-land, the per-netjer temple-houses, the niut river-cities, construct toponyms Per-/Niut-/Ta-, breathy vowels and dj/tj/kh, aspect-based verbs over the substrate)
blend.lean: Celtic-heavy - a Goidelic mercenary-dynasty enthroned on the Nile: a fian war-host of Galatian guardsmen (Celtic spears hired by the river-kingdom) seized the delta-cities and set themselves up as warrior-kings over the temple-priesthood and the scribal populace; the cattle-raiding hero-clans rule, the per-temples and the river-kingdom endure and serve beneath.

_note: NEW cross-family hybrid under the base/hybrid model. BASE_02 (Celtic / Insular Goidelic) x BASE_05 (Egyptian / abydosian river-kingdom). CIV/CLAN DECIDED by inheritance: Celtic base = Clanhold, Egyptian base = Civilized, and any Civ parent -> Civ, so Radon is Civilized (feudal). Concept: Celtic mercenary-dynasts in the Nile delta - the Galatian guardsmen who truly served Ptolemaic Egypt, here a fian war-host that seized the river-cities and enthroned itself as a feudal warrior-aristocracy over the existing temple-priesthood, scribes, and river-cities of the Egyptian kingdom. Backbone = Celtic (GOIDELIC/Insular: the ruling war-aristocracy, the ri/tuath/flaith register, Mac-/O- patronymics, the fian war-band, initial mutation); overlay/substrate = Egyptian (the itru river, the per-netjer temples, the niut river-cities, the scribal and priestly populace, the Per-/Niut-/Ta- construct toponyms). Common-word lexicon and rank titles use the real Gaelic and Egyptian registers (allowed, catalog 5.3); DEITY names are morphs of the Agrippan canon from both parents (CELTIC reflexes primary - the family_celtic theonym_set; Egyptian morphs secondary - the abydosian deity-morphs), never real Celtic/Egyptian gods. The kingdom-tier DISPLAY ruler is the approved foreign term 'Pharaoh' (the Egyptian realm's iconic throne, which the Celtic dynasts assumed); the conlang Goidelic form sits in ruler_native. [2026-06-27: all human cultures allow Lawful/Neutral/Chaotic. Ruler/domain DISPLAY titles are English (or an approved foreign term); conlang titles are in ruler_native/domain_native for NPC dialogue. Deities are the canonical Agrippan pantheon via the per-family morph method.]

phonology.palette: Insular Celtic (Goidelic) backbone - initial consonant mutation (lenition c>ch, b>bh, t>th, d>dh; nasalization), broad vs slender consonants, root-initial stress, the fian/ri/tuath register, vowels a e i o u (long marks dropped) - meeting an Egyptian overlay: dj/tj/kh, l tends to r, v tends to w, the long -aa and feminine -et endings, breathy reconstructed vowels. Per the CSV: breathy vowels and liquid consonants - the Egyptian breathiness carried on the soft, lenited Goidelic liquids (the bh/dh/mh and the broad/slender l, r, n); grammar is VSO with root patterns and mutations (the Insular-Celtic VSO order and the Egyptian root-pattern templates meeting in the mutation system). Theophoric on the Celtic reflexes (Toran-, Orlann-) with Egyptian construct variants (Tjuraa-, Djeroraa-).
phonology.phonotactics: CV/CVC; mutation-driven Goidelic clusters (ch, bh, dh, mh) meeting Egyptian dj/tj/kh onsets and long -aa codas; root-initial stress with a breathy Egyptian vowel-quality; Goidelic personal names over Per-/Niut-/Ta- construct toponyms.

sound_changes: Egyptian onsets folded into the Goidelic inventory: dj > d/g (slender d before front vowels, g before back), tj > t, kh > ch, q > c; the Egyptian liquids already lean r, the breathy w stays
Egyptian -aa / -et endings drop or shorten to the Goidelic shape: long -aa > -a or bare consonant, feminine -et > -e/-id, the construct -t softens; roots take Goidelic broad/slender colouring
Goidelic initial mutation lives on the substrate roots too: lenition c>ch, b>bh, t>th, d>dh, m>mh applies to fused stems in compound/genitive position
Goidelic root-initial stress on every word; broad-vs-slender consonant pairing imposed throughout, so the Egyptian roots are re-voweled to one Goidelic colour-pattern
retain Goidelic ch, bh, dh, mh and the slender l/r/n; retain a faint Egyptian dj/kh in a few sacral/material roots so both ancestries stay audible
fusion_rules.source_tilt: land/river/material/staple words from Egyptian roots (the conquered Nile-folk keep their itru-river, sekhet-fields, bia-iron, it-grain) re-shaped to Goidelic phonology; kin-line/quality/abstract/rule/war words from Goidelic roots (the fian war-aristocracy's ruling register: mor, derg, sen, ard, iarn, mac); every root then run through one sound-law so the split is inaudible at the surface

lexicon._note: Single fused tongue derived via phonology.fusion_rules (gdd-hybrid-conlang-fusion.md): Egyptian land/river/material/staple roots re-shaped to Goidelic phonology + Goidelic kin/quality/abstract/rule/war roots, all run through one Goidelic-dominant sound-law (lenition, broad/slender, root-initial stress); portmanteaus mark the blended bloodline and the shared institutions (kin, fort, temple, citadel, city). One word per concept, no slashes.

morphology.patronymic_form: the Goidelic ruling stock keep the Mac- (son of) / O-Ua (descendant of) patronymic and the cland/fine kin-group; the Egyptian populace keep the 'sa-' (son of) filiation and theophoric constructs; the throne fuses both - a ri who also carries a Per- house-name.
morphology.compounding_rule: Goidelic [quality|feature](stem) + element (Dun-derg, red-fort; Ard-mor, great-height) layered over Egyptian construct-chains (Per-[god], Niut-[god], Ta-[noun]): the capital Mag Itru (the river-plain), Per-Toran (temple-city of Toran), Ta-Orlann (the iron-land).

title_ladder.government: feudal (a Goidelic war-aristocracy over the Egyptian river-kingdom: the ri and his flaith-kin at the crown, the toisech-chiefs over the niut-cities, the fian-spears sworn to the war-host; the hem-netjer priesthood and the scribal per-aat serve beneath)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Insular Celtic (Goidelic) ladder, ascending, with the Egyptian substrate co-titles beneath. Aire (noble) barony; Maor (warden) march; Toisech (sept-chief) county over a Toisecht; Flaith (lord) duchy over a Flaithes; Ri Tuaithe (king of a tuath) principality; Ruiri (over-king) kingdom - the enthroned Celtic over-king who assumed the Egyptian throne, displayed as Pharaoh - over a Morthuath; Ard-ri Nesut (the high-king; Goid. ard-ri + Eg. nesut) empire over the Ard-rige. The conquered river-cities keep their Egyptian sepati (nomarch) and hem-netjer (priest) beneath the Goidelic crown; the per-aa style survives as the highest sacral honorific of the enthroned ruiri. The brithem (judge) and fili (poet-seer), and the Egyptian wab and hem-netjer, stand outside the ladder. Rank titles fuse the real Gaelic and Egyptian registers (allowed).
title_ladder.heir: Tanaiste (the heir-elect / second); Sa-Nesut (king's son, Egyptian style)
title_ladder.display_policy: Ruler/domain titles shown in setting-gen, domain lists and vassal trees are ENGLISH (or an approved commonly-known foreign term where set in 'ruler'). The *_native conlang forms are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY, never for structural/UI displays.

people_name_convention.order: the Goidelic ruling stock carry a personal name + Mac-/O- patronymic and cland/fine; the Egyptian populace carry a theophoric given name + sa- filiation; order given-first.
people_name_convention.dual_register: the Goidelic war-aristocracy keep Gaelic names + a praise-epithet from the fili (Conall, Cormac, Mac-, O-, the Hound, the Red); the Egyptian river-folk keep theophoric names (X-hotep, Mery-X, Sa-X) on the morphed canon-stems.
people_name_convention.theophoric: Goidelic devotional on the morphed Celtic reflexes (Mael-Toran, Gilla-Orlann, Cu-Orlann); Egyptian devotional constructs: Tjuraa-hotep (Tjuraa-is-content), Mery-Djeroraa (beloved-of-Djeroraa), Sa-Riaret (son-of-Riaret).

religion._note: Deity-names are morphs of the Agrippan canon - CELTIC (Insular / Goidelic) reflexes PRIMARY (family_celtic theonym_set), Egyptian morphs SECONDARY (the abydosian deity-morphs), never real Celtic/Egyptian gods. All three alignments: the Lawful keep the sun-and-oath powers, the Neutral the ancestral war-dead and the land and river powers, the Chaotic the war-fury and raven powers; the druidic drui/fili and the Egyptian hem-netjer mediate side by side.
religion.the_one: Eternan (Eg. Atjernaa) - the Ancient One beyond the god-kin, the hidden distant maker, honored not petitioned

Tulrius.gloss: the sun, the just brightness and right-order

Gaiandus.gloss: the enduring land, the black alluvial earth

Delorum.gloss: death, the rest of the dead, lord of the peaceful dead

worship_by_alignment.Lawful: venerates the Lawful powers - Eternan, Toran the just (the sun above the feather of right-order), Orlann of the sworn oath-war, Realtan the merciful - and names the Chaotic powers as the warded ill-kin (Goid. namnamed at the cairn; Eg. framed as -kin of the great serpent Hefau), unworshipped; the fian's sworn oath and the just over-king are the social ideal
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: the ancestral war-dead (the deified heroes of the ruling cland and the Tuath-de) and the akhu / justified dead of the per-temples and the river-land; the great powers invoked at the nemed-grove and the per-netjer situationally rather than worshipped wholesale
worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: Venerates the Chaotic powers of the canon - the war-fury and the raven - and names the Lawful powers, and Eternan, as the tyrant-gods to be defied.

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the Chaotic powers keep their morphs + a portfolio epithet (distinct per power; warded at the cairn and framed as -kin of the great serpent Hefau): Maraxus -> Maragan the War-Fire (Eg. Marakhu the City-Burner); Vacidus -> Faicid the Unmaker (Eg. Wakedjet, the Devouring Hefau); Lusanto -> Losand the Hoard-Worm.
religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Nemed (Goidelic sacred grove) or Per-netjer (Egyptian god's-house) of [power]: 'the Nemed of Toran', 'the Per-netjer of Tjuraa'.
religion.saints_pattern: the Tuath-de (the god-kin) and the ancestral heroes of the ruling cland (honored at the cairn and the holy well) and the akhu / justified dead (maa-kheru) of the river-kingdom, venerated at the tomb-temples and the per-netjer.
